title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・Lost…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion loses the Queen Elizabeth II Cup she so desperately hoped to win, and her frustration is plain to see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her strong desire to win opens up Fine Motion to the true joy of racing. However, she finds the feeling to be one she'd be better off not knowing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To make matters worse, Air Shakur confronts her with the harsh truth that she has only a single year of running left. The joys she has come to know will end up as nothing more than memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Fine Motion acts as cheerful as ever, I can tell from her face that she feels conflicted. With her career approaching its end, we get ready for the Osaka Hai.
